    return [[grid[len(grid[0])-1-j][i] for j in range(len(grid[0]))] for i in range(len(grid))]

def rotate_180(grid):
    return [row[::-1] for row in grid[::-1]]

def create_output(input_grid):
    n = len(input_grid)
    tl = [row[:] for row in input_grid]
    tr = rotate_90_ccw(input_grid)
    bl = [[input_grid[r][n-1-c] for r in range(n)] for c in range(n)]
    br = rotate_180(input_grid)
    
    output_up = [tl[i] + tr[i] for i in range(n)]
    output_down = [bl[i] + br[i] for i in range(n)]
    
    output = output_up + output_down
    return output
